title: Prefix Matrix Products
prompt:
Implement prefix products over a sequence of square matrices, plus a manual backward pass.

`prefix_matrix_products(W)` receives a Torch tensor `W` with shape `(N, D, D)` and returns `P` with the same shape, where `P[i] = W[0] @ W[1] @ ... @ W[i]`.

`prefix_matrix_products_backward(W, grad_P)` receives the original matrices and an upstream gradient tensor `grad_P` with the same shape as `P`. Return `grad_W`, the gradient of `sum_i <grad_P[i], P[i]>` with respect to each `W[i]`.

Use the product rule directly. If `P[i] = W[0] ... W[i]`, then output `i` contributes to matrix `k <= i` as `left.T @ grad_P[i] @ right.T`, where `left = W[0] ... W[k-1]` and `right = W[k+1] ... W[i]`. Keep the implementation small and correct before thinking about scan optimizations.
